PARISH ANNOUNCEMENT (September 27, 2026)
We warmly welcome everyone to Mater Dei Cathedral Parish, a place of excellence. Thank you for your presence and active participation. We are glad you are here and do not take it for granted. God bless you as you worship with us.
We celebrate all the September birthdays. We ask God to grant you more fruitful years ahead.
There will be a parish council meeting on Wednesday, September 30, 2026, at the usual venue at 4:30 pm.
Today is the day set out for the launch of priests’ insurance. Let us donate generously. Each priest is to pay 50k annually. 
St. Theresa’s group of CWO would be sharing their support in all the Masses. Kindly support them.
Catechesis/Benediction is held today at 4:30 pm, following the Rosary at 4 pm. We encourage all to attend.
The 2026 catechetical week will run from Sunday, October 4, through Sunday, October 11, with the theme: You shall have no other gods but me (Ex. 20:3). The booklet in Igbo and English is sold for N1,500. Kindly get a copy.
We encourage all our parishioners to subscribe for a space in the parish harvest brochure. God bless you.
Catechism Classes for those preparing for Adult Baptism, First Holy Communion, and Confirmation have resumed and are held every Saturday and Sunday at 2 pm here at the Cathedral. We encourage everyone to make the most of this precious time.
Please turn off or silence your mobile phones and refrain from using them during Mass. Let us give God our full attention and maintain a prayerful atmosphere throughout the liturgical celebration. Thank you.
Regarding security, we recommend that everyone install a security device or a pedal lock on their cars. Please take your tag with you and do not leave it in your car. From now on, cars will not be allowed to leave the premises during Mass. You may leave only after Mass. Let us stop the Judas Movement.
We encourage parishioners to support and use our parish facilities, including the Jubilee Auditorium and the Palm Garden for events and gatherings, as well as the Mater Dei Bakery, which offers a variety of breads.
We encourage parents to allow their children to attend the Children’s Mass every Sunday at 8:30 am in the Cathedral Underground Hall. 
This is the Year of St. Francis of Assisi, and our theme this September is on Education and culture. Kindly see the flex outside for this year's various diocesan programs.
We want to remind our parishioners that the regular weekly morning Masses at Ehimiri Mass Center are held Tuesday through Friday at 6:15 am. Thursday’s adoration is at 4:30 pm.
We want to remind everyone that donation boxes for St. Vincent de Paul are located at all entrances and exits of the Cathedral. We encourage everyone to contribute to help those in need. You can also donate to St. Vincent de Paul at Mater Dei Cathedral via the UBA account (1029653369).
 The parish charity store is open on Sundays after all Masses and on all days of the week from 10 am to 5 pm. You can donate all kinds of items, including foodstuffs and anything you wish to give.
We encourage all the Catholic young people to register with the parish CYON
All the vice president/assistant secretaries are to meet in front of the Father’s house after 8:30 am.
There will be choir rehearsals for all those who participated in the Parish competition on Tuesday, September 29, 2026, at 4 pm, in preparation for the Sunday Mass on Sunday, October 4, 2026
